Hinglish spelling-variant lexicon (hinglish_variants_R.tsv, hinglish_variants_Rplus.tsv)

This lexicon is derived from the Dakshina dataset v1.0 (Roark et al., 2020,
https://github.com/google-research-datasets/dakshina), which is released under the
Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International licence (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Changes from the original:
  * Each romanization is mapped to its most-attested native-script word.
  * The R+ file adds strings generated by five phonetic rules.

This derived lexicon is therefore also released under CC BY-SA 4.0:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
